title: SAM2 causal memory surgery (validated upper-bound diagnostic)
most_dangerous_objection: Predictive-validity leg (r>0.6 vs SAMURAI/DAM4SAM gains) can pass via shared sequence-difficulty confound: reversible fraction and prevention gains both track distractor density/failure severity, so the instrument gets validated without measuring anything causal
other_fatal_flaw_candidates: Targeted-deletion arm forces pre-error memories into recency slots they never occupied (temporal-position-encoding artifact can create or destroy the targeted-vs-reset gap); SAM3 (Nov 2025) + SAM3.1 (Mar 2026) shipped and arXiv:2512.22624 (Dec 2025) already systematizes SAM2/SAM3 memory design across 10 benchmarks - SAM2.1-only study reads as archaeology; reset-style repair now published (CL-MC arXiv:2602.19380)
hidden_assumptions: Harvest yields >=200 usable organic failures from LVOS v2 val (140 videos) + DiDi; SAM2 inference-state memory dict is separable per object and replay from arbitrary t_r is bit-faithful; comparator per-sequence gains stable without seeds
implementer_blockers: DiDi access (go.vicos.si, no mirror) confirm day 1; surgery hooks ~300 LOC plus extra sham arm; SAM3 port if added ~1-2 weeks + HF-gated checkpoints; 1x A100-40GB otherwise trivial
reproducibility_risks: Failure-harvest definition has free parameters that determine the corpus (headline parameter-sensitive); mitigated by releasing failure corpus + toolkit
new_prior_work_found: SAM3/SAM3.1 released (arXiv:2511.16719); arXiv:2512.22624 Rethinking Memory Design in SAM-Based VOT (SAM2+SAM3 memory zoo); CL-MC arXiv:2602.19380 detector-triggered memory overwrite - crowding, not a direct scoop of the causal decomposition
decisive_experiment: 50-failure pilot with targeted vs reset vs no-op vs temporal-sham arms + difficulty-partialed regression: targeted beats reset AND sham by >=10pts and partial-r>0.4 flips me to strong KEEP; targeted~sham flips me to KILL
pivot_or_keep_conditions: (1) P3 becomes difficulty-partialed validity test (preregister partial r>0.4 controlling no-op recovery/failure count/distractor density); (2) add temporal-encoding sham-deletion control; (3) add SAM3-tracker arm or explicit staleness argument with pilot
expected_disagreements: Oracle-timed upper bound deployable-knowledge vs academic; race-vs-rigor on SAM3 porting cost; whether temporal-encoding concern is overblown (sham arm settles it)
resurrection_if_dead: If killed: promote A-0002 (same SAM-mechanism lane, ~30 GPU-h killer, no SAM3 dependency)

title: Wrong-support counterfactual FSS audit
most_dangerous_objection: Post-SAM3 significance decay: SAM3 exemplar-prompted concept segmentation (75-80% of human on SA-Co) makes a specialist-centric (PFENet/HSNet/BAM) audit an indictment of a museum; headline must move to foundation-era methods
other_fatal_flaw_candidates: Killer leg (b) hostage to floor choice (SAM AMG vs classical SOD floor can flip the verdict on same data); wrong-class support sampling not exchangeable across queries on COCO-20i (co-occurrence structure confounds strata); retention ratio unstable at small IoU_correct
hidden_assumptions: Distractor-present stratum thick enough for power at 1000 episodes/fold; per-repo episode samplers differ (shared episode lists load-bearing); area matching within +/-50% adequately controls saliency prior
implementer_blockers: Checkpoint link rot is the #1 practical risk (BAM OneDrive, HSNet Google Drive) - archive and re-hash day 1; 7 support-injection wrappers trivial; SAM3-exemplar arm needs HF-gated access; zero training zero annotation
reproducibility_risks: Lowest of the five: public checkpoints + fixed episode lists + released distractor-enriched split; wrong-support draws must ship as fixed lists not seeds
new_prior_work_found: No published counterfactual wrong-support audit found (searched again this session); only mitigation methods (TBS AAAI24, AENet ECCV24, OCNet ICCV25) and support-dilution line (arXiv:2501.13529); SAM3 exemplar mode partially subsumes FSS task framing
decisive_experiment: MVE (PFENet+BAM+Matcher on PASCAL-5i f0 + COCO-20i f0, ~1 A100-day) plus one foundation-era arm (FSSAM or SAM3-exemplar) in the same pass: all methods incl. modern <20% retention everywhere = demote behind alternate; any modern method >35% on distractor strata = cheapest headline of the five
pivot_or_keep_conditions: (1) add SAM3-exemplar arm and make foundation-era retention co-headline; (2) preregister BOTH floors and report leg (b) against each; (3) fixed wrong-support lists with near/far-class strat promoted into killer; (4) day-1 checkpoint archival
expected_disagreements: Whether the certification-negative branch is top-venue or eval-track; specialist panel slots vs all-foundation panel; whether medical transfer probe dilutes
resurrection_if_dead: n/a (KEEP); if killed anyway: M5/B-0362 desk-survey-gated is same-lane replacement

title: Boundary Nyquist cutoff-ratio table
most_dangerous_objection: Two-world dichotomy ill-posed: the single output-grid oracle cannot separate training-limited from encoder-limited (1024 input resize and 64x64 token grid are coarser upstream band limits than the 256^2 logit path) - the preregistered headline mis-attributes in exactly its expected branch
other_fatal_flaw_candidates: Lane crowded by aliasing-score line (arXiv:2403.09065 + AAAI 2026 Revisiting Downsampling + CVPR 2026 CROWn) - first-frequency-resolved framing gone; P2 octave-shift only cleanly testable within HQ-SAM dual paths (cross-model comparisons confound resolution with recipe)
hidden_assumptions: A knee exists (segmented regression R^2>=0.8) vs smooth roll-off; marching-squares at logit grid does not itself alias; EFD harmonic index comparable across scales only after arc-length normalization; textured composites in-distribution enough
implementer_blockers: Nearly none: all checkpoints public, DIS-5K academic license, single GPU, ~500 LOC stimulus generator + oracle ladder; cheapest of the five by an order of magnitude
reproducibility_risks: Low; synthetic suite with analytic GT released; residual analyst degrees of freedom in knee-fitting - preregister the segmented-regression spec
new_prior_work_found: arXiv:2403.09065 When Semantic Segmentation Meets Frequency Aliasing (equivalent Nyquist, aliasing score, boundary hard-pixel link); AAAI 2026 dynamic Gaussian/Gabor filters; CVPR 2026 CROWn - image-space encoder-side analyses; contour-frequency transfer function vs decoder operating point still unclaimed
decisive_experiment: MVE (300 stimuli, SAM ViT-B vs HQ-SAM, ~2 GPU-h) WITH the oracle ladder: cutoffs pinning to 64^2 token-grid oracle = encoder-limited finding (my flaw becomes the result); cutoffs below every oracle rung = training-limited genuinely supported; no knees = kill at 2 GPU-h
pivot_or_keep_conditions: (1) replace single oracle with oracle ladder across all band-limiting stages (input resize, token grid, logit grid, output upsample) - verdict becomes binding-stage attribution; (2) position explicitly against aliasing-score line and include it as covariate; (3) demote P2 to model pairs with real within-family resolution variation
expected_disagreements: Whether contour-frequency formalism adds decisions beyond boundary-F + aliasing score; design-law framing vs honest per-architecture datasheet; how synthetic/natural disagreement would scope claims
resurrection_if_dead: n/a (PIVOT keeps it alive; if killed: A-0002 same-cluster cheap replacement)

title: Blending-artifact detectability -> transfer-gap law
most_dangerous_objection: The law's x-axis may not exist as engineered: libcom/PCTNet/BargainNet/MadisNet are RGB natural-image models pointed at CT (middle rungs inject their own out-of-domain artifacts) and the composite-vs-real probe can saturate on synthetic lesion texture on every arm, leaving no AUROC spread
other_fatal_flaw_candidates: Spearman rho<=-0.8 across n=5 arms is one adjacent flip from failure and real liver-tumor DSC is seed-noisy (3 seeds may not stabilize arm ordering); seam-residual injection along GT boundaries of real images leaks GT localization into the attribution test; 2026 fix wave makes blending-matters folklore-with-fixes by submission time
hidden_assumptions: Seam residual is content-independent and injectable; DiffTumor STEP3 shortened to 1000 epochs preserves arm ordering; slice-wise harmonization can be made inter-slice consistent
implementer_blockers: CT-native compositing engineering (3D Poisson, consistent feathering) ~2-3 weeks and is the fix for the main flaw; LiTS competition license complicates releasing composited volumes (plan recipe+code release); 30-run training grid = second-largest compute of the five
reproducibility_risks: Moderate: compositing ladder must be reproducible via released recipes/seeds since LiTS-derived volumes may not be redistributable
new_prior_work_found: SRA-Seg arXiv:2602.02944 (soft edge blending fix, Feb 2026); TumorGen arXiv:2505.24687 (boundary-aware synthesis); Texture-Shape Dilemma arXiv:2603.00985 (boundary aliasing named, Mar 2026) - fix wave concedes premise, but detectability->gap law at fixed content + reverse injection still unclaimed; fastest scoop clock of the five
decisive_experiment: ~1 A100-day pre-MVE: arm (i) + one CT-native blended arm; train probe composite-vs-real AND composite-vs-composite; probe spread >=0.15 AUROC with sane volumes = KEEP at nominee strength; spread <0.05 = KILL regardless of folklore
pivot_or_keep_conditions: (1) replace middle rungs with CT-native compositing, demote RGB-harmonizer arms to appendix; (2) texture-controlled probe (composite-vs-composite) so x-axis measures seams; (3) re-preregister law criterion for arm-count reality (>=7 rungs, monotonicity + CI-backed effect size, not point rho); (4) keep flat-DSC MVE kill gate
expected_disagreements: Whether generative in-fill rung belongs inside the law (relevance vs generator confound - no clean answer); whether hygiene-number audit should ship without the 30-run causal grid; medical vs CV venue statistics standards
resurrection_if_dead: If killed: promote M5/B-0362 (desk-survey gated, near-zero GPU) with B-0112 Leg-1 MVE as backup

title: Text rehearsal = gradient rebalancing not content
most_dangerous_objection: LLaVA-1.5's published 665K mix already contains text-only rehearsal (ShareGPT ~40K slice): 'no-rehearsal floor on the exact published recipe' is self-contradictory as specified - A0 requires a recipe deviation and A1 partially duplicates the native mix
other_fatal_flaw_candidates: Two of four capability strata have unusable retention denominators (Vicuna-7B near-floor on GSM8K, weak IFEval - ratio metrics amplify noise and the >=3-of-4 rule can flip on it); mechanism space colonized in real time (Dynamic Gradient Guidance arXiv:2511.15164, MoDE NeurIPS 2025, Srivastava PMLR v330) though content-free controls remain unclaimed; single family/scale thin for a stop-paying-for-curation headline
hidden_assumptions: 1-epoch 7B forgetting large enough to power the 80%-of-gap rule per stratum; gradient-norm matching achievable without destabilizing training; shuffled-token arm produces intended unigram-preserving control rather than degenerate attention; deepspeed configs pin cleanly on maintenance-mode LLaVA repo
implementer_blockers: Largest compute of five (~2.3-2.45K A100-h on 8xA100-80GB); ShareGPT provenance legally murky (defensible by precedent); Vicuna/LLaMA-2 community license OK research; C4 ODC-BY fine
reproducibility_risks: Moderate-low: all public; frozen eval YAMLs pre-registration is best practice; residual hardware-config sensitivity of 8xA100 deepspeed runs - publish exact configs + loss curves
new_prior_work_found: Dynamic Gradient Guidance (arXiv:2511.15164 Nov 2025); MoDE modality-gradient-conflict (NeurIPS 2025); Srivastava et al. CL-for-MLLMs published (PMLR v330 2026, real-data rehearsal only) - no content-free-control study found; scoop window open but months not years
decisive_experiment: First 6 runs (A0/A1/A2 x 2 seeds on text-stripped base) with per-stratum power analysis: knowledge+fluency A1-A0 gap <2x seed-sigma fires the kill clause (<1K A100-h spent, argue against 13B escalation, reallocate to C-0028); well-powered gap with A2 landing anywhere clearly = highest-ceiling KEEP of the five
pivot_or_keep_conditions: (1) redefine arms against preregistered text-stripped base mix with token-budget accounting; published-recipe run kept as reference not arm; (2) per-stratum power/denominator gates, absolute deltas co-primary, swap floor-effect strata if pilot shows floors; (3) 1-run A3 tokenization sanity pilot before seeding; (4) add 3-run cross-family replication (prismatic-vlms A0/A1/A2)
expected_disagreements: Whether mushy-middle dosing recipe is practice-change or a shrug (hinges on funding the mixture-sweep runs); whether Robins-1995 subsumption survives review; portfolio fight: 2.3K A100-h here vs C-0028's decision triple
resurrection_if_dead: n/a (KEEP); if killed at power gate: C-0028 (flagship, 5.2K A100-h) or C-0302 (cheap, narrow) per lane preference
